description: Near completion, supposedly fixed punch-list items keep reappearing, and the team needs to track what was closed, reopened, deferred, or never truly addressed.

user_profile.persona: 44-year-old closeout manager trying to prevent completion drift
user_profile.context: The project is late enough that repeated reopenings are starting to consume disproportionate attention
user_profile.communication_style: Closure-minded and evidence-based, wants a durable record of punch-list status changes

fact_sheet.fact: The project is named 'Apex Tower'.
The official project identifier is 'APX-2023-01'.
The construction site is located at 123 Zenith Avenue, Meridian City, MC 45678.
Elena Vance is the Closeout Manager for the general contractor, Stonework Construction Group.
Marcus Thorne is the Site Superintendent responsible for trade coordination.
David Chen is the foreman for the electrical subcontractor, VoltWorks Electric.
Brenda Russo is the foreman for the plumbing subcontractor, AquaFlow Plumbing.
James Caldwell is the client representative from Orion Commercial Properties.
Punch list item PL-078, for a flickering lobby chandelier, was marked 'Closed' on May 15, 2024, and reopened by Elena Vance on May 22, 2024.
Item PL-112, a non-functional GFCI outlet on the 3rd floor, was changed to 'Deferred' on May 10, 2024, due to backordered parts.
Item PL-045, a misaligned door frame in Suite 502, has been reopened three times, most recently on May 16, 2024.
A water stain issue, item PL-201, was reopened on May 20, 2024, after a new stain appeared, indicating a persistent leak from an AquaFlow Plumbing pipe.
Item PL-155, a grinding noise from HVAC unit #4, was reopened by Elena Vance on May 19, 2024, with an attached audio file as evidence.
The official punch list tracking software is ProCore, accessible at the URL https://app.procore.com/login.
Elena Vance's username for ProCore is 'evance_stonework'.
A new status, 'Pending Verification', was added to the ProCore workflow on May 20, 2024, to prevent premature closures.
The ProCore report ID for the weekly 'Reopened Items Summary' is 'RPT-PUNCH-REOPEN-003'.
As a policy, any status change in ProCore requires an attached photo or video as evidence of completion or recurrence.
Any punch list item that is reopened more than twice is automatically escalated to the Site Superintendent, Marcus Thorne.
Subcontractors are required to submit a 'Root Cause Analysis' form (Form PCA-02) for any item that is reopened for a second time.
Closing a punch list item requires digital sign-off from both the subcontractor's foreman and a Stonework Construction Group representative.
A mandatory daily punch-list stand-up meeting is held at 7:30 AM in site trailer #1.
The official policy states that all communication regarding reopened items must be logged in the ProCore item's comment thread, not via email or text.
Elena Vance distributes a 'Weekly Punch List Reopening Analysis' email every Friday at 4:00 PM to project stakeholders.
The last weekly analysis report was sent out on Friday, May 24, 2024.
The original contractual date for substantial completion was April 30, 2024.
The revised target for 100% punch list completion and project closeout is June 15, 2024.
The penalty clause for project delay, as per contract section 8.2, is $5,000 per calendar day.
The final client walk-through with James Caldwell is scheduled for June 10, 2024, at 9:00 AM.
The project's official definition of a 'Closed' punch list item is: 'Work completed, inspected by Stonework, and verified as meeting contract specifications.'

user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing the history of a specific reopened item (N5), the user will want to verify the overarching policy for providing evidence to ensure it's being followed.
